name: AI doc review gating system
description: A verification layer for an AI agent that reviews documentation PRs: evidence artifacts pinned to commit SHAs, a beforeShellExecution hook that physically blocks unverified posts, and a feedback loop that converts review lessons into mechanical checks. Built on top of my team's agent tooling. The code is internal; the thinking is public in the articles.
